name: Bimm
description: The Bimms were a sentient species characterized by their fur, feather-like whiskers and long, floppy ears. They spoke a language called Bimmini. A Bimm named Uumay Hawlatha served as a Jedi Master in the late Republic Era, while Voh was an elderly Bimm male who served as the seneschal of the Jedi outpost Sanctuary Mount on the planet Kwenn. A different species, similar to diminutive humans, was also called Bimms.
